YOUR JOURNEY, DAY BY DAYExplore the 3-day programme
DAY01

Bodhgaya

  • Reach Gaya Airport by morning, afternoon & evening.
  • Pick up from airport and proceed to hotel.
  • Participate in the evening worship at the Mahabodhi Temple.
  • Overnight stay at hotel.

Meals Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

DAY02

Bodhgaya

  • Visit the Mahabodhi Mahavihara Temple and meditate under the bodhi tree.
  • Discover the surroundings and experience the majestic Great Buddha Statue.
  • Feel the peace of Mahakala Cave (Dungeshwari Hill).
  • Overnight stay at hotel.

Meals Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

DAY03

Bodhgaya Morning, Afternoon Departure — A Time For Final Reflections.

  • Visit the Sujata Temple and Stupa in the morning.
  • Depart from Bodhgaya with lasting memories of the Sanghapathways Tour India.

Meals Breakfast & Lunch

BUDDHIST SACRED PILGRIMAGE · INDIA & NEPAL

Across the sacred lands

From Varanasi to Lumbini, journey through the Buddhist circuit before a reflective finish in Bodh Gaya.

START
Varanasi
FINISH
Bodh Gaya
DURATION
7 nights / 8 days
VaranasiSarnathShravastiLumbiniKushinagarKesariyaVaishaliRajgirNalandaBodh Gaya
Enquire about this tour ↗Download itinerary ↓Branded PDF
YOUR JOURNEY, DAY BY DAYExplore the 8-day programme
DAY01

Varanasi

  • Reach Varanasi Airport by morning, afternoon & evening.
  • Pick up from airport and proceed to hotel.
  • Attend the sacred Ganga Aarti held at the ghats during the evening.
  • Overnight stay at hotel.

Meals Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

DAY02

Sarnath – Shravasti

  • Discover the historic Dhamek Stupa, Mulgandha Kuti Vihar, and Chaukhandi Stupa at Sarnath.
  • Travel to Shravasti, a place of great spiritual significance.
  • Visit the major sites of Shravasti, including the Jetavana Monastery.
  • Overnight stay in Shravasti.

Meals Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

DAY03

Shravasti – Lumbini

  • Visit more places in Shravasti during the morning.
  • Proceed to Lumbini, the birth place of Lord Buddha.
  • Explore the Maya Devi Temple, the Ashoka Pillar, and the sacred gardens of Lumbini.
  • Overnight stay in Lumbini.

Meals Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

DAY04

Lumbini – Kushinagar

  • Travel to Kushinagar, explore the Mahaparinirvana Temple and the Ramabhar Stupa in Kushinagar.
  • Overnight stay in kushinagar.

Meals Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

DAY05

Kushinagar – Vaishali – Rajgir

  • On the way to Vaishali, visit the magnificent Kesariya Buddha Stupa.
  • Explore the historic landmarks of Vaishali, such as the Ananda Stupa and the Buddha Relic Stupa.
  • Continue your pilgrimage to Rajgir, where an overnight stay awaits.

Meals Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

DAY06

Rajgir – Nalanda – Bodhgaya

  • Visit Venuvan, Bimbisara Jail, Nalanda University and Gridhakuta Hill in Rajgir & Nalanda.
  • Reach the sacred land of Bodhgaya and enjoy a serene overnight stay.

Meals Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

DAY07

Bodhgaya

  • Discover the spiritual calm of Mahakala Cave (Dungeshwari Hill) and Sujata Stupa.
  • Discover the local attractions and marvel at the majestic Great Buddha Statue.
  • Experience the spiritual ambiance of the evening worship at the Mahabodhi Temple.
  • Overnight stay at hotel.

Meals Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

DAY08

Bodhgaya Departure – A Spiritual Journey Remembered

  • Visit the holy Mahabodhi Mahavihara Temple and reflect peacefully under the Bodhi Tree.
  • End your Bodhgaya visit with a heart full of memories from the Sanghapathways Tour India experience.

Meals Breakfast
